{{Quote|A report detailing the location of these deposits was taken from the Imperial shipping platform. Unfortunately, it has somehow ended up in the hands of Selkath bureaucrats, in the heart of their so-called 'visitor's center.'|Commander [[Qrukk]]|<ref name="TOR:MtN">{{TORcite|exp=lots|type=faction|Imperial|Map to Nowhere|Manaan}}</ref>}}
The '''Manaan Visitor's Center''' was a tourist center located on [[Manaan/Legends|Manaan]]. It was run by the [[Department of Selkath Ethnology]], a sub-organization of the [[Office of Extraplanetary Relations]], in order to promote and preserve [[Selkath/Legends|Selkath]] culture. The main visitor's center was above the surface, but a second facility, the [[Exploration Dome]], was below the surface to allow individuals to observe Manaan flora and fauna in their natural environment.<ref name="Codex"/>

The Manaan Visitor's Center was taken over by the [[Syphus Collective]] during the [[Third Galactic War]].<ref name="TOR:SSJ" />
